from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687599/attempts/9fae27520975411b8cb0cf3c60079e38/system/state/workspace')
(base/'programs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg)
    fill = 2
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row)-1):
            if row[c] == bg and row[c-1] in colors and row[c+1] in colors:
                out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''
path=base/'programs'/'task-a00df3a5.py'; path.write_text(code)
exec(code)
